newsitem.title: UK: Emirates ups ex-UK air cargo rates 5pct on April 1.
newsitem.headline: Emirates ups ex-UK air cargo rates 5pct on April 1.

text.p: Emirates will raise its ex-UK air cargo rates to all destinations by five percent from April 1, UK cargo manager Ray Disson told Reuters.

The ex-UK cargo fuel surcharge of six pence a kg introduced late in 1996 along with many other airlines remains in force but:" will come off as soon as the fuel price returns to the level of July last year," he said in a telephone interview.
Emirates' last rate changes took place in October 1996 with a mix of increases and cuts, he added.
Earlier this week, British Airways PLc World Cargo announced cargo rate increases from March 17 to a wide range of cities.
These include many of the Middle Eastern, Asian and Australian destinations served by Emirates and other airlines, industry sources said.
